profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. Its site describes it as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site describes the Appian Platform, on which customers build AI-powered processes, integrate systems, and build applications without code, embedding AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Named uses include accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier data, audit workflows and attestations, case intake and resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review and approvals. Appian says onboarding time can be cut by up to 50 percent. It states it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT) and points to an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

Legal exposure records for the company count 152 matters in Virginia. No lawsuits are listed for it.
